name: excel-ai-copilot
description: Excel task-pane add-in: AI copilot for building reports, dashboards and answering questions about a workbook.

comments.no-build-step: The add-in itself has no build step and no runtime dependencies. It is plain <script> tags over static files, served as-is. This manifest exists only so `npm test` can run the Node built-in test runner against the pure-JS modules.
